messages:
marie: Quick sync 1: proposing a small floating mini-controls for the playground chat while streaming. It should include: single stop/pause control, a compact token counter, and a prompt-library quick-insert icon. Prototype link: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar-v2 (figma). ash: Nice start. Where does it sit relative to suggestions/composer? Mobile vs desktop? marie: Desktop-first for this iteration. Bottom-right above composer controls so suggestions remain visible. On small widths collapse to a single icon that expands on tap. sam: Implementation heads-up: live token updates per chunk may cause paint thrash. Let's debounce to ~200-300ms and avoid reflow by using transform updates. Also: stopping a stream is a cancel request, yes? ash: Yep. UX-wise we should differentiate "Interrupt" (stop but keep what's streamed) vs "Restart" (stop and start fresh). Primary action should be a single visible "Stop"; put regenerate/restart under a small menu to avoid accidental triggers. ben: Idea: when user hovers prompt-library insert, show "+N tokens" small pill to make cost explicit. Could also show it in a tooltip on keyboard focus. kai: Accessibility: set streaming region to aria-live="polite" so screen readers don't read each chunk. Stop/regenerate must be keyboard operable and the toolbar should be reachable in the tab order. Token meter needs an explicit aria-label like "tokens: 123". a11y-bot: Checklist: keyboard-only flow, test with VoiceOver/NVDA, ensure token meter color palettes meet contrast and there is a non-color cue. marie: Draft microcopy: Stop button label = "Stop" tooltip "Stop generation — keep partial". Regenerate label = "Regenerate" tooltip "Restart generation from prompt". Keep tooltips concise. ash: Shorter tooltips for narrow toolbars: "Stop — keep" and "Regen — restart". Also add a confirmation delay or undo after regenerate? sam: Engineering preference: regenerate should replace content by default and offer a temporary toast "Response replaced — Undo". That simplifies state. ben: For token meter visuals propose three modes: dot+number (collapsed), bar+number (compact), and sparkline (expanded). Default to compact. Ensure number is readable at small sizes. kai: Keyboard nav: toolbar should be in reading order, and pressing Esc should stop the stream and return focus to the composer. Confirm no conflict with global shortcuts. Honor prefers-reduced-motion for appearance animation. marie: Also: prompt-library insert should not steal focus unexpectedly. If a user is actively typing, insert should be inert unless they choose "Insert & focus" from the small menu. Otherwise screen readers lose context. sam: Sample markup:
...
120 This plus debounced DOM updates should be fine. ben: UX risk: toolbar might overlap composer suggestions. Add a collision detector and nudge it left or float it above composer when suggestions are displayed. ash: Add a subtle fade+translate animation on show/hide; reduce motion when user prefers reduced motion. kai: Token meter must not rely on color only. Use icons and text. Contrast check for the token meter background and foreground required. marie: Next actions: ash to refine Figma comps with collapsed/compact/expanded states; sam to prototype debounce & Esc behavior; ben to spec quick-insert token delta microcopy and undo toast; kai to run a quick a11y pass on the comps. I'll collect outcomes and update in the design sync. :sparkles: ash: I'll add a short PR checklist when comps land. :+1: sam: I'll push a prototype branch today and paste a GIF in this thread. ben: I'll prepare tooltip/undo copy: "Response replaced 1 Undo" / button label "Undo". kai: Will run VoiceOver test once Figma is ready. marie: Thanks all. Closing for now, will post updated comps. :eyes:
